description: O72 Protosynthesis's bestStat reads stat stages: at the battle start Incineroar's Intimidate (priority 0) lowers Great Tusk's Attack (153 -> 102) before Protosynthesis (priority -2) picks Defense (151) in Drought's sun, so Incineroar's Strength meets a 5325/4096 Defense and Great Tusk's own Strength gets no boost. Torkoal and Snorlax Harden.
